response.rationale: R3 is the only candidate with definitive support from both brain biopsy immunophenotype (CD19+, CD20+, BCL6+, MUM-1+, EBV/EBER−) and CSF lymphoma cells, which are diagnostic of primary CNS lymphoma. R4 is contradicted by the absence of contrast enhancement and the biopsy. R7 and R5 are contradicted by the biopsy and CSF findings, with R5 additionally ruled out by EBV/EBER negativity. The imaging pattern is non-specific and shared by several candidates, but the pathological and CSF evidence decisively favor R3.

rejected.why: Absence of contrast enhancement and biopsy results (CD19+, CD20+, BCL6+, MUM-1+) are inconsistent with glioblastoma.
Biopsy and CSF lymphoma cells rule out multiple sclerosis; no oligoclonal bands or other MS-specific findings.
EBV/EBER negativity and biopsy immunophenotype exclude progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy; CSF lymphoma cells indicate a lymphomatous process.
